item.description:
What's new in 0.10.0

  • The menu and its folders now behave identically everywhere. Every gesture — hovering, flicking, arranging, the pill that stays lit after a slow swipe — runs on one shared rulebook for both rings, so a folder can never react differently than the main menu again
  • The first interaction after opening is instant: the graphics warm up in the background at launch, removing the slow first hover
  • Arrange mode feels tighter: all wiggling pills rock in sync, the pill you grab always rides above everything else, and a linked pair's grey link mark stays glued to its pair through every drag and swap
  • Moving a lit pill's selection to another pill now needs actual contact with the new pill — fast sweeps past other pills no longer steal the selection
  • The arrows inside folders now give the same hover sound as everything else

What's new in 0.9.0

  • Folder arrange is finished: every combination of what you hold and where you aim now does one defined thing. Mains swap with mains, a linked couple trades its whole slice, an unlinked pair moves one half at a time, and dragging a pill onto its own outer seat swaps the two sides of that slice
  • The fan waits for you to stop. While your hand is still travelling across the ring nothing rearranges — it reacts when you pause, and it holds the picture it is showing instead of snapping back the moment you leave a seat
  • Releasing is always instant: drop a pill before the pause elapses and it lands immediately, exactly where the blue target said
  • The grey link marks stay with the pair they belong to: they no longer vanish mid-drag, follow the wrong pill, or slide across the ring when two slices trade
  • A folder can grow at either end — drag a pill past the first or the last slice and a new slice opens there. A linked couple moves to it whole and can never be split by a drag
  • Drag from the Pill Library straight into a folder you are arranging
  • Undo and redo reach every arrange gesture, and the undo bar sits clear of the outer pills
  • Main ring: swap is the default everywhere — hold Option to shift the whole row instead. The outer pills, the empty outer seats and the link marks all travel on the same glide as the mains, so a whole slice moves as one piece
  • Switching modes with a swipe now replaces the ring in the direction you swiped, and every menu you land in announces itself with the same sound
  • The App Launcher's icon-only look now applies to its outer pills too, and a folder's look carries to every face inside it
  • Dictation works while the menu is up — the menu hands the keyboard over instead of swallowing it
  • Faster drops: saving your arrangement no longer stalls the release (about 120ms off every drop), and hovering costs nothing while the target is unchanged

What's new in 0.8.11

  • Folder arrange, finished: dragging a pill now shows exactly where it will land — one blue target for a single pill, two for a linked couple (it takes both seats) — and the pills that have to move step aside while you drag, so releasing changes nothing you haven't already seen
  • Linked couples travel as one slice and can't be split by a drag or have half of them evicted; open (unlinked) pairs move independently — drag a main onto a main and only the mains swap
  • Both layers now animate identically: outer (⌥) pills travel on the same glide as the mains instead of springing into place
  • Undo and redo in arrange mode: ⌘Z / ⇧⌘Z, plus buttons above the ring
  • Deleting a pill in arrange asks first, and deleted pills are kept in the Pill Library's History
  • Pill Library at the top-right of arrange mode: your saved pills, deleted pills, and a suggestion made from whatever link you last copied — drag any of them straight into a slot
  • Edits apply immediately: changing a pill's safeguard, label or colour now takes effect without closing and reopening the menu
  • A pad tap can't switch menus while you're dragging in arrange
  • The menu-bar volume slider uses the full width of the menu
